text: For SuppressSourceGeneration = true types, should the analyzer still report the general contract diagnostics (MsgPack003/004/005/006/007) as in 3.1.0, or only skip the generation-only ones (MsgPack011/016/017)?
options: Keep reporting general contract diagnostics; skip only MsgPack011/016/017
Skip all diagnostics for suppressed types (current change)
why_it_matters: If the first, the early return is too broad and the new tests encode wrong behavior (high defect). If the second, the requirement 'analyzer still reports diagnostics' is reinterpreted and tests are adequate for that scope.
